snippet.title: Dylan Israel
snippet.description: Coders and inspiring programmers have come to the correct channel. Daily uploads of multiple object oriented programming languages. Specializing with JavaScript and its frameworks such as jQuery, Angular, React and more. Most of the content is focused around online tutorial sites such as Codecademy, FreeCodeCamp and CodeCombat.
